title: OmiCraft
description: OmniCraft is a crafting station plugin for RPG/MMO Paper servers. It focuses on MMOItems-style crafting, clear requirements, AdvancedEnchantments extraction, and strict server-side transaction safety.
body:
# OmniCraft
**The Ultimate Professional Crafting System for RPG & MMO Servers**

*<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/7bGByNIKBfE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>*

OmniCraft is a high-performance crafting station plugin designed for modern Paper/Spigot servers. It bridges the gap between complex RPG mechanics and user-friendly interfaces, allowing server owners to create deep, immersive crafting experiences without touching a single line of YAML.

<details>
<summary>Click to view Full Text Transcription (Accessibility Required)</summary>

Core Concept
OmniCraft is built for server administrators who demand precision and ease of use. It transforms how players interact with professions by providing a visual, secure, and highly customizable crafting environment.

Key Features
*   **Intuitive Visual Editor (GUI):** Create, edit, and manage complex recipes directly in-game. No more reloading or syntax errors in YAML files.
*   **MMO-Grade Integration:** Built-in native support for **MMOItems**, allowing you to use custom items, stats, and tiers as ingredients or results.
*   **Intelligent Resource Recovery:** 
    *   Automatically extracts **Gemstones** from socketed items used in recipes.
    *   Safely retrieves **AdvancedEnchantments** during the crafting process.
*   **Flexible Requirement System:** 
    *   Set custom **Crafting Times** (with progress bars).
    *   Assign **Permission Nodes** for profession-based crafting.
    *   Implement **Cooldowns** to balance the server economy.
*   **Transaction Security:** Features a robust server-side validation system to prevent item duplication or loss during lag spikes.
*   **Advanced Result Logic:** Supports multiple output possibilities and custom success rates.

Technical Compatibility
*   **Supported Platforms:** Paper, Purpur, Spigot (1.20 - 1.26+).
*   **Required Dependencies:** [MMOItems](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/mmoitems.39267/) (Highly recommended for full functionality).
*   **Hooks:** AdvancedEnchantments, PlaceholderAPI.

How it works
1. Open the OmniCraft admin menu.
2. Drag and drop your ingredients and results.
3. Set your conditions (time, permissions, gems extraction).
4. Save and your players can now use the new Crafting Station!
